'''Ayam Goreng''' is an Indonesian fried chicken dish. This version features an accompanying butter sauce.

== Ingredients ==
=== Chicken ===
*1 medium-sized [[cookbook:chicken|chicken]], cut into small pieces (12–16 pieces)
* Juice of 2 [[cookbook:lemon|lemon]]s
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:salt|salt]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] frying [[cookbook:oil|oil]]

=== Sauce ===
* 4 cloves [[cookbook:garlic|garlic]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 1 small [[cookbook:onion|onion]], thinly sliced
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
* 2 tbsp [[cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
* 2 tbsp regular [[cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]] (tamari)
* 2 tbsp Chinese cooking [[cookbook:wine|wine]]
* 8 tbsp [[cookbook:Soy Sauce|Indonesian sweet soy sauce]] ([[Cookbook:Kecap Manis|kecap manis]])

=== Garnish ===
* Slices of 2 [[cookbook:lime|lime]]s

== Procedure ==
#Season the chicken pieces with salt. Coat with lemon juice, and let [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] for 15–20 minutes.
# Heat the oil to about 350°F (180°C), and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] chicken until it is golden. Remove chicken from oil, and set aside to drain.
#[[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the garlic and onion for a minute or two. Add the remaining sauce ingredients.
# [[Cookbook:Stir-frying|Stir fry]] for a minute and then add chicken pieces. [[Cookbook:Tossing|Toss]] to coat.
#Serve hot with lime wedges. 

== See also ==

* [[w:Ayam goreng|Ayam Goreng]]
